prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Purpose: original buildable environment concept art for a premium survival game set in an abandoned, drowned subtropical coastal city several generations after people left. Invent solely from this written description. No photographs, no other game's imagery, no existing franchise designs.
Medium: polished digital PAINTING in stylized realism, high-end game art, confident designed forms, rich tactile materials, believable warm late-afternoon sunlight and cool sky fill in shadows. Handsome, restrained, specific. Not photoreal photography, not cartoon, not loose sketch.
Palm construction: every crown consists of distinct pinnate feather fronds with a visible midrib, many slim leaflets on both sides, a rising arch and drooping tip. Open wedges of sky between fronds; clear radial crown star. Never fan palms, banana leaves, fern blobs or fuzzy green balls. Individual trees vary in age, height, lean, crown fullness, missing fronds and minor scars. All crowns grow radially in 3D and work from every azimuth.
Royal: nearly straight smooth pale grey column, subtle swell below mid-height, taper toward a glossy bright green 1.5–2 m crownshaft, 3–4 m arching fronds, compact elevated crown; mature height 14–20 m, trunk about 0.5 m wide with 0.6 m swell. Coconut: slender grey-brown ringed trunk 9–14 m along its curve, 0.3–0.4 m wide, leaning outward then rising, occasional kink/S curve, broad loose 8–10 m crown of 4–5 m drooping fronds, coconuts and old flower stalks just under crown, 0–3 hanging dead brown fronds. Bases flare gently into very tight low mats of thin roots immediately around the trunk, never sprawling roots, buttresses or root stilts.
Output: one finished PNG, landscape canvas, maximum native resolution available; aim for 3840 x 2160. No watermark or decorative border.
Asset: grove_far.png, the most important composition in the set.
Paint an expansive distant view from roughly 400 m across a bay toward a low subtropical city hillside and a curving shore. View spans roughly 750 m of coastline. Warm light from upper left. The hillside occupies the left two thirds, turquoise bay the right and lower right, pale sand arcs around a shallow inlet. At the foot of the hill a broken boulevard curves along the shore; pale collapsed concrete building shells interrupt the vegetation; scattered drowned foundations at the water. A low broken seawall is a recognizable mid-right landmark. Atmosphere softens distant ridge but keeps middle distance crisp.
HUNDREDS of palms spread over the slope and shore, in broken former boulevard rows, irregular groves, separated pairs and lonely survivors. Palms are THE subject. All trees are genuinely distant: no hero foreground tree, no large framing palm, no oversized foreground foliage. Most individual trees only 30–80 pixels tall on a 3840px-wide image, all smaller than 5 percent of frame height. Leave many open dry grass/sand patches so isolated trunks can be read. Some clusters overlap, but no continuous shaggy green carpet. Each distant palm must resolve to a thin trunk line with a distinct dark green angular star of 6–9 projecting curved feather-frond groups and empty spaces between them. Royal palms read as pale erect lines with narrower high stars; coconut palms as grey-brown bent lines with wider asymmetric drooping stars. A few crown tips catch yellow green sun; undersides stay deep olive green. Plant fresh green, mature olive and occasional straw crowns in uneven believable distributions. Distant low hardwood and mangrove masses only sparingly as lower rounded supporting shapes.
Make the rhythm of lean, the thin lines and the separation of dark stars against ochre grass, pale ruins, cool teal sea and hazy blue sky the visual achievement. Beautiful credible game world, not a resort, no modern active city, no mountains dominating, no birds, no labels, no text. A 1.8 m person on the distant boulevard, correctly near-pixel size, may be barely perceptible; do not enlarge the person.
